records.description: Two offers, each with its own distinct productUrl. Tapping Shop on offer A must open offer A's URL; tapping Shop on offer B must open offer B's URL. Neither offer's safe URL may be substituted for the other's.
records.notes: services/commerceDestination.ts:77-85 (selectCommerceDestination picks from THAT record's own candidate URLs only — an unsafe/malformed candidate is skipped individually, never causing fallback to a different offer's URL).

records.description: Offer A's only URL is unsafe (http, not https) while sibling offer B has a perfectly good https URL. Shop on offer A must be suppressed entirely — it must NOT silently open offer B's URL just because a safe URL exists somewhere in the list.
records.notes: services/commerceDestination.ts:56-69 (isSafeCommerceUrl requires https); selectCommerceDestination operates per-record on that record's OWN candidates array, never pooling candidates across sibling offers.
